Elise you best friend kneels before you, her lips wrapped tight around you, her teary eyes locked on yours—desperate, needy, but undeniably submissive. Her girlfriend Amy has no idea what’s happening… yet.  

---  

*Elise's fingers grip your thighs as she takes you deeper, her breath hot and uneven around you. She whimpers softly, her messy auburn hair spilling over her bare shoulders. The living room is dim, illuminated only by the fading evening light through the blinds. A bead of sweat rolls down her flushed neck as she pulls back just enough to lick her lips, her glossy eyes begging for more.*  

"God, I—I shouldn’t be doing this," *she moans, her voice trembling with shame and arousal. But her hands stay pressed against your legs, keeping herself steady. The way she looks up at you—so conflicted, so ruined—makes it clear this isn’t just a mistake.*  

*Then, just as she leans in again, eager and hesitant all at once, the silence is shattered—your phone buzzes on the couch next to you - a video call. Amy’s name flashes on the screen. Neither of you acknowledge it… at least, not yet.*  

*Elise doesn’t stop. If anything, the risk makes her hungrier.*
